index.heading: What is PicoShare?
index.intro: PicoShare is a service for sharing images, videos, and other files.
index.uploaderInfo: On PicoShare, only you can upload files. You can share links to those files with anyone, and they never have to sign up for an account.
index.controlIntro: PicoShare puts you fully in control, which means:
index.benefit1: You can share direct download links without forcing your guests to see ads or prompts to sign up for an account.
index.benefit2: There are no restrictions on file type, size, or content.
index.benefit3: PicoShare never resizes or re-encodes your media files.
index.benefit4: PicoShare preserves the original filename and metadata for your files.
index.selfHosted: PicoShare is easy to self-host. See our source repo for details.
index.author: PicoShare is written by Michael Lynch and licensed under the open-source AGPLv3 license.

setup.heading: Set Up Single Sign-On
setup.intro: PicoShare only offers OpenID Connect single sign-on, such as Synology SSO Server. Register PicoShare as an application in your identity provider first, using the redirect URL below, then paste its details here.

systemInfo.heading: System Information
systemInfo.reclaimableNotice1: PicoShare's database files occupy more disk space than the sum total of PicoShare's file uploads.
systemInfo.reclaimableNotice2: After files are deleted, PicoShare temporarily retains the space as reclaimable space. PicoShare returns reclaimable space to the filesystem during database cleanup, which runs at startup and every few hours, or when you select "Clean up now."
systemInfo.cleanupIntro: Cleanup deletes expired files and old download history and returns reclaimable space to the filesystem.
